name: 48631 · Kawkawlin, MI
findings: ZIP 48631 (Kawkawlin) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48631 (Kawkawlin) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48631 (Kawkawlin) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
